description: Record a post-formation change to an existing Agent Company: add or remove a principal, change the agent's mandate (powers, wallets, spending/risk limits), rename the company, change the management model, or add the Wyoming USD subsidiary. Creates an amendment record for the OffshoreProz team to review and file (including any beneficial-owner update with the Nevis registered agent). Like create_formation_request, this NEVER files with a government automatically — it records a request for human review.

details.description: Describe the change precisely — e.g. "Add principal Jane Doe at 10% ownership", "Raise agent per-tx limit to $25k", "Add Wyoming USD subsidiary".

request_id.description: The request_id (UUID) of the Agent Company to amend.

requested_by.description: Name of the person or agent requesting the change (for the audit trail).

name: request_amendment
